decision: Resolve T01-SG001 prospectively. Fix MCP protocol version 2026-07-28, stateless STDIO and Streamable HTTP POST /mcp transports, an exact 13-tool catalog containing nine PURE_READ and four DURABLE_PLAN_ARTIFACT tools, exact shared result and error envelopes, provider-neutral Python handlers, plugin-host adapters, authorization and confidentiality ordering, no read receipts or business mutations, receipt-bound non-executing planning artifacts, and the exact T01 contract, runtime, adapter, documentation, fixture, test, evidence, manifest, and acceptance-matrix scopes. Authorize only T01-0002 and prohibit T02 mutations, session state, SSE fallback, duplicated business logic, and broad src or tests authority.
rationale: T01-0001 correctly stopped because tool names alone did not define wire contracts, transport framing, side-effect classes, authorization, shared handler ownership, or executable acceptance thresholds. This decision freezes those contracts while retaining domain JSON Schemas as canonical and keeping execution-capable MCP tools outside T01.
